name: io.github.JheysonJhordyHuarauyaRiquelme/sprocguard
title: sprocguard
description: Safety net for SQL Server stored procedures: capture their behavior and verify changes.

environmentVariables.name: SPROCGUARD_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to sprocguard.toml (defaults to ./sprocguard.toml in the working directory)

environmentVariables.name: SPROCGUARD_ODBC
environmentVariables.description: ODBC connection string; overrides the connection in sprocguard.toml

environmentVariables.name: SPROCGUARD_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: SQL login password, only when the config uses user/password_env
